title: Hynek and Vallee's Invisible College and its Rosicrucian namesake

tellings.quote: I think about the invisible College which was jlen heck's group with jacqu Valle which is a tongue and- cheek reference to Robert Bo's invisible College which was kind of at the start of the Enlightenment

plain: The UFO researchers J. Allen Hynek and Jacques Vallée called their private group of fellow investigators the Invisible College, and Michels says the name was a tongue-in-cheek nod to the Invisible College of the scientist Robert Boyle, a circle from around the start of the Enlightenment. Michels tells this himself, drawing on a book by the historian Frances Yates about how the Rosicrucians, a secretive mystical movement, fed into the birth of modern science. He brings it up to suggest that UFO research sits in a long line of half-hidden groups pursuing knowledge at the edge of science and mysticism.
